title: Same-origin policy bypass in the Networking: HTTP component
description: CVE-2026-8950 is a vulnerability in Microsoft’s Networking: HTTP component that allows bypassing the same-origin policy. The same-origin policy is a critical security mechanism that restricts how documents or scripts loaded from one origin can interact with resources from another origin. This vulnerability could potentially allow unauthorized cross-origin interactions. The affected version is Microsoft version 4.0. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild. No patch or remediation details are currently available.
